description: Two sets of questions, each with the section that answers it. 'paraphrase': phrased the way a cardholder would put it, avoiding the policy's words. 'agent': phrased the way the investigator queries after reading the case data, in the vocabulary of the ledger and the policy. Retrieval quality is measured on both with the real embedding model.
